strongest_comparator: The preceding canonical comparison plus normal compensator has a finite weak limit, but does not identify that compensator with the original local shape action. The nonlinear trace theorem leaves this complete pure-shape coefficient as the only possible persistent cancellation within its stated expansion.
hardest_step: Match both logarithmic bulk and boundary coefficients in the unchanged Weyl action, retain density derivatives, and bound every remaining classical, Weyl, counterterm and LLL contribution on H2 logarithmic profiles without a pointwise second-jet assumption.
new_consequence: The full original pure-shape quadratic coefficient has a finite translated-logarithmic weak cutoff limit. The nonzero persistent trace/action vector therefore obstructs a family satisfying the stated first/second-order expansion, original equations through second order, and ordinary convergence of its literal quadratic cutoff coefficient.
scope_boundary: This does not prove that every exact physical solution admits that expansion or that differentiation in amplitude commutes with removal of the cutoff. The zero-fast-amplitude sector, other controlled nonlinear families and physically justified boundary completions remain to be assessed. No Lorentzian instability or stable wormhole is established.
regulator_contract: Original finite action, paired domain, Euclidean period, fixed background cut, state, flux and common subtraction. Retain conversion fluxes, finite interior values, GHY, intrinsic and loop counterterms. Include the declared LLL once. No physical cutoff averaging, new finite term or order reduction is selected.
verification_scope: All-monomial local weight audit, independent complete normal Weyl polynomials, density/compensator identities, unexpanded complex-contour Hessians, normal Weyl remainder integrals and analytic tail enclosures, concentrated critical boundary contacts, and compact translated tests of the trace vector. These support the ordinary argument and do not evaluate a physical shape solution or the full charged kernel.
